levels.name: Alchemist
levels.description: A practical scholar whose every thrown vial stings twice. At star one she has no mana to charge - just the acid doing its quiet work on every hit.

levels.name: Alchemist
levels.description: Stronger acid, heftier flask. The Volatile Mixture fires when the flask charges full - a bubble of debuffs that soaks an entire cluster in Vulnerability and Slow.

levels.name: Alchemist
levels.description: The strongest acid, the widest blast, and a lasting pool of toxic residue that punishes any enemy who tries to walk through the crater. The battlefield map no longer belongs to fast melee units.

levels.name: Crown Heir
levels.description: The Crown Heir at rank one contributes nothing beyond their physical presence. Place them safely - they are the investment that pays out when the shop upgrades. On level-up it branches into Queen (option 0) or King (option 1) - AI picks at random; player choice UI still pending (/ux-design).

levels.name: The King
levels.description: The King at rank two - formation commander. His global Sovereign's Aura passively buffs all Nobles' Armor and Attack Damage; Royal Command surges all stats on mana full.

levels.name: The Queen
levels.description: The Queen at rank two - frontline fighter. Her Vanguard Aura buffs nearby Noble Attack Speed; Sovereign's Charge dashes to the highest-HP enemy and stuns.

levels.name: High King
levels.description: The High King at rank three - the ultimate formation multiplier. His global Sovereign's Aura II buffs all Nobles; Royal Command II surges the entire formation; King's Protection grants adjacent Nobles Last Stand once per combat.

levels.name: High Queen
levels.description: The High Queen at rank three - frontline fighter supreme. Her Battle Cry triggers on every kill, driving the Noble formation into a frenzy.

levels.name: Enchanted Rat
levels.description: A enchanted grey rat, quick and twitchy.

levels.name: Rat King

levels.name: Jester
levels.description: The wildcard of the Noble faction \u2014 unpredictable, disruptive, and oddly dangerous for a clown. Distract spreads incoming damage by confusing enemy targeting, keeping the Jester alive longer than its HP suggests. On full mana, Tumble leaps onto the furthest enemy and hops back.

levels.name: Jester
levels.description: Distract chance raised to 30%. Tumble II now Stuns on landing \u2014 leaping into the enemy backline to Stun clustered enemies and escaping before they can retaliate.

levels.name: Jester
levels.description: Distract chance 35%. Tumble III: Stun 1.2s, and a kill chains into another leap (up to 3). Passive: every 3rd basic attack randomly grants a nearby ally +15% Attack Speed for 3s \u2014 the Jester becomes a passive support unit even when Tumble is on cooldown.

levels.name: Knight
levels.description: The cheapest defensive unit in the Nobles roster. Pure stats tank - the reliable frontline anchor that taunts nearby enemies when hit.

levels.name: Knight
levels.description: Shield Bash gives the Knight offensive pressure. On Mana Full, the Knight stuns the primary target and raises a shield barrier for itself.

levels.name: Knight
levels.description: Shield Bash II - Stun the primary target (1.5s) and raise a +35 HP Shield. Also stuns all enemies adjacent to the primary target (0.8s, unsupported - adjacency AoE pending engine implementation).

levels.name: Plague Caster
levels.description: The Arcane Academy's anti-heal specialist. Every attack infects the target with Wound, halting regeneration and rendering healing futile. A single Plague Caster counters an entire sustain composition.

levels.name: Plague Caster
levels.description: Wound intensifies to \u221250%. Plague Spray fires 5 bolts at random enemies on mana full, spreading Wound instantly across the enemy board and shutting down faction-wide healing simultaneously.

levels.name: Plague Caster
levels.description: Wound reaches \u221270% for 5s. Each Plague Spray bolt now also applies Vulnerability (+20% damage taken, 3s) - combining no-heal and damage-amplify on every target hit. Paired with a Rat Enchanter, a target receives +60% effective incoming damage.

levels.name: Purrciful the Bard
levels.description: The core force multiplier of the Peasants. Her aura makes a weak army dangerous just by her presence. Protect her, or let her death echo be plan B.

levels.name: Royal Archer
levels.description: Gains Volley at full mana \u2014 fires 3 arrows at 3 different enemies. Precision Shot line-of-sight bonus increases to +20% AD.

levels.name: Royal Archer
levels.description: Volley fires 5 arrows, each applying Vulnerability. Precision Shot line-of-sight bonus reaches +25% AD \u2014 devastating behind a Knight wall.

levels.name: Royal Cavalry
levels.description: A mounted knight who builds speed on the ride in and crashes into the enemy line.

levels.description: The charge now slows everyone around the impact.

levels.name: Silence Caller
levels.description: The Arcane Academy's hard-CC caster. On Mana Full she unleashes Hush, Silencing her target and stripping their ability window entirely.

levels.name: Silence Caller
levels.description: Hush II extends Silence to 4s and adds a follow-up Stun - the target staggers upon regaining ability access, double CC from a single cast.

levels.name: Silence Caller
levels.description: Hush III: Silence 5s + immediate Stun 1.5s, and the silenced target takes +20% damage for 5s.

levels.name: Sir Aldric
levels.description: The Nobles' foremost Paladin. A methodical, unshakeable presence who hardens through combat. Heavy tank with no mana at rank one. Steadfast raises his Armor and Magic Resist over time.

levels.name: Aldric, Sworn Shield
levels.description: Gains Divine Shield on mana full \u2014 Unbreakable for 4s and a +60 HP barrier. Steadfast grants +3 Armor and +2 Magic Resist per stack.

levels.name: Aldric, Unbroken
levels.description: Divine Shield grants Unbreakable for 4s and Shield +100, and Tenacity +10% for 4s to allies within 2.5. Steadfast grants Armor and Magic Resist per stack.

levels.name: Stray
levels.description: A scrappy alley cat who answers the call for a bowl of leftovers.

levels.name: Tipsy Toes
levels.description: A tipsy Tavern recruit. Never sold in the shop.

levels.name: Tomeowto Thrower
levels.description: Wren the Hurler lobs tomeowtos from safe range. Fragile but punishing \u2014 every throw has a 20% chance to Stun the target for 0.5s.

levels.name: Tomeowto Thrower
levels.description: Wren hones her aim. Each throw now slows on hit too, and her stuns land harder. Still fragile - but harder to ignore.

levels.name: Tomeowto Thrower
levels.description: The Giant Tomeowto. Wren launches an oversized tomeowto that stuns all enemies in a small area. Paired with Barrage she can hold an entire flank from across the board.

levels.name: Village Elder
levels.description: An ancient cat whose name no one knows. He carries a staff worn smooth from decades of use. His aura of blessing strengthens allies within 5 tiles \u2014 slow to move, impossible to rattle.

levels.name: Village Elder
levels.description: He has seen worse. The Elder's blessing now reaches 7 tiles and deepens for every ally within range. He does not hurry. The battle comes to him.

levels.name: Village Elder
levels.description: At his strongest the Elder's aura fills the entire field (8 tiles). Those who stand in it do not merely fight harder \u2014 they endure.

levels.name: Ballista
levels.description: A polished oak-and-iron siege crossbow on a swivel mount, dressed in Crown Guard livery. Fires at the highest-HP enemy in range, ignoring a portion of their armour.

levels.name: Heavy Ballista
levels.description: Reinforced limbs and heavier bolts. The bolt now pierces through the primary target, striking the first enemy behind them for reduced damage.

levels.name: Royal Arbalest
levels.description: Reinforced limbs engraved with gold plate. The heaviest siege crossbow in the Crown Guard arsenal. Every fourth bolt is a Skewer Shot that tears through the target's Max HP.

levels.name: Catapult
levels.description: A heavy timber siege engine with indigo-and-gold Crown Guard banners on its frame and a counterweight stamped with the royal crest. Hurls boulders into dense enemy clusters.

levels.name: Trebuchet
levels.description: A taller frame with counterweights doubled. Boulders scatter survivors with Knockback on impact, clearing the hit zone.

levels.name: Grand Trebuchet
levels.description: A towering trebuchet with ceremonial gold fittings and the royal crest on its counterweight. Stuns enemies at the inner impact zone. On destruction, launches one final boulder.

levels.name: Chapel
levels.description: The Peasants' dedicated healing building. Heals the lowest-HP ally on a pulse, keeping the frontline alive.

levels.name: Milk Tavern
levels.description: The Milk Tavern drafts Peasant Fighters during combat, giving the Peasants an endless stream of cheap bodies to fill the front row.

levels.name: Milk Tavern
levels.description: Production interval drops by 25%. The first Fighter arrives instantly at combat start, and every spawn briefly gains All Stats \u2014 milk-fuelled and ready for battle.

levels.name: Milk Tavern
levels.description: The Tavern at full production. Two Fighters arrive instantly, the interval halves, and spawns gain permanent All Stats. If the Tavern falls, every Fighter it ever sent surges with Attack Damage as a final gift.

levels.name: Stone Grimalkin
levels.description: A weathered stone cat-grotesque crouched on a carved plinth. Stationary ward - enemies that enter its aura are slowed. Wakes when an ally dies or it drops to half HP, rising as a Roused Gargoyle for the rest of combat.

levels.name: Roused Gargoyle
levels.description: The stone cracks and the gargoyle wakes. The Magic Cats' only true frontline tank - slow but heavily armoured. Looming Presence travels with it as a moving ward, slowing enemies who press against it.

levels.name: Grand Grimalkin
levels.description: Tower-tall, moss-grown and rune-scored. The Grimalkin at full power - when mana fills it unleashes Stone Smash, slamming the ground to damage and knock back all enemies in a 2-tile radius. Looming Presence now reaches 4 tiles.
